notes: The FY2026 20-F (year ended March 31, 2026) gives employees for India (258,502), the Americas (32,718), Europe (19,176) and the rest of the world (18,198), total 328,594. No single-country figure outside India, and no U.S. state breakdown, is given. The SEC copy of the 20-F is used (the infosys.com annual report PDF returned HTTP 403 to automated requests in the earlier edition). Sites come from the 20-F table of most significant properties (buildings over 500,000 sq ft or land over 440,000 sq ft), in this column order: location, building sq ft, seating capacity, ownership, land sq ft, ownership; the Bengaluru headquarters row is now labelled 'Infosys E City' (it was 'Infosys City Main Campus'). The 20-F says Infosys has a presence in 290 locations across 59 countries. The 20-F lists Hyderabad under Andhra Pradesh; it is now in Telangana, so place omits the state.
